$comment: Post-PR loop only: watch CI, get an external review, fix, repeat, merge with human approval. The minimal entry point — attach conductor to PRs you open yourself. Roles must be mapped to your project's agents/models in your own config.

pipeline.prompt:
CI for PR #{{feature.pr}} is red on SHA {{feature.head_sha}}.
Failed checks:
{{steps.await_ci.output}}

Work in {{feature.worktree}}. Diagnose, apply the smallest fix, commit and push. When done, call conductor_report with outcome=succeeded (or failed with a reason if you cannot fix it).

Review PR #{{feature.pr}} (repo {{config.repo}}) at SHA {{feature.head_sha}}.
Read the diff with gh, inspect the code in {{feature.worktree}} (read-only).

Previously recorded findings (do not re-raise fixed/dismissed ones):
{{findings.digest}}

On repeat rounds judge ONLY the new commits since your previous review. Do NOT raise new minor/nit findings on code you already approved — approved means approved. If a fixed/dismissed finding is genuinely NOT addressed, say so in the summary and report it again with body prefixed '[reopen F<n>]'.

Report your findings STRUCTURED: pass notes as a JSON object {"summary": "<overall assessment, markdown>", "findings": [{"path": "src/file.ts", "line": 42, "side": "RIGHT", "severity": "blocker|major|minor|nit", "tags": ["correctness"], "body": "<what is wrong + what you expect>"}]} — the conductor records each finding in its database (the source of truth), publishes the review to the PR under the configured identity, and routes the findings to the fixer. Do NOT post to GitHub yourself.
Severity: blocker = broken behaviour/data loss/security; major = bug or missing error-path test; minor = real improvement; nit = taste. Omitted severity counts as major.
Verdict follows findings: any blocker or major => changes_requested; only minor/nit => approved.
Then call conductor_report with verdict=approved or verdict=changes_requested and those notes.
